104-3490-4050-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-8333.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

983-2645-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
983-2645-3181-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-2645-3181-3430.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-1832-5231-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-5933.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

728-2158-3220-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3220-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

851-2557-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1669-3861-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

413-4559-7810-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4559-7810-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-4113-7525.easyPrerequisites: Striking Palette must have valid targets.
1170-4113-7525.description:
Cast Striking Palette using the convoke ability from Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Pigment Wrangler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Pigment Wrangler, which enters prepared.
Resolve Striking Palette.
Repeat.

440-2428-6996-7426.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-2428-6996-7426.description:
Draw a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and The Destined White Mage trigger.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

997-3240-6351-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4896-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two tapped lands on the battlefield.
5231-6972-7232.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

3525-4028-4289.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6155-6662.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-6662.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

944-3140-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

681-4693-4826-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-4693-4826-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2750-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1978-2750-3443.description:
Cause Deathbloom Ritualist to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat from step 2.

262-3263-4853-5686.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3525-6723-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

700-3096-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
700-3096-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
700-3096-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing you to draw 100 cards and win the game when you would draw from an empty library due to Jace.

4120-4968-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
4120-4968-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
4120-4968-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Deathbringer Thoctar, but instead putting 100 +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar 100 times by removing 100 +1/+1 counters from it, dealing 100 damage divided among any number of targets.
4120-4968-6758.notes: You can forego step 2 if you just want the counters. Alternatively, you can target creatures you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them.

1329-2178-3652-3698.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-3698.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

465-647-3742-4251-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-647-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

654-1170-1418-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2187-3603.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Possessed Skaab exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-2187-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2558-2829-4848-5687.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2896-2921-5145.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

215-3000-3426-4050.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deranged Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-3302-3883.notablePrerequisites:
Otherworld Atlas has at least one charge counter on it.
You have at least two opponents, or Otherworld Atlas has at least two charge counters on it.
1651-3302-3883.description:
Activate Otherworld Atlas' second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card for each charge counter on it and create that many Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Otherworld Atlas.
Repeat.

1189-1965-2500-4600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1189-1965-2500-4600.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Omarthis until end of turn.
Resolve the Omarthis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Mirage Mirror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 5 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.

2233-3936-4050.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-3936-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Core Prowler, adding one mana of any color.
When Core Prowler dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Core Prowler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

823-2292-2577-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 4.
You control an additional Zombie.
823-2292-2577-4740.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Defiler of Flesh trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Defiler of Flesh trigger, giving target creature +1/+1 and menace until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

540-746-4474-4763.description:
Activate Paradise Mantle by paying {0}, attaching it to Fervent Champion.
Activate Fervent Champion by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Mask of Immolation's ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Fervent Champion.
Activate Fervent Champion's ability from Mask of Immolation by sacrificing it.
Koll triggers, returning Fervent Champion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Fervent Champion ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Fervent Champion by paying {R}.
Repeat.

654-1671-1912-3869.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Gretchen Titchwillow by paying {G}{U}, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1133-2730-3518-5112.description:
During your upkeep, activate Mairsil by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Mairsil dies, triggering Kaya's Ghostform, returning Mairsil from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mairsil using Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mairsil.
Repeat.

338-1496-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Scurry Oak.
You have a way to gain life.
338-1496-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the amount of life gained.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1762-2034-4484-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Wilhelt's triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zombie token, adding {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2103-2493-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2103-2493-3742.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is tapped and attacking.
Archaeomancer enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

391-3664-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3664-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
